fields.name: addressType
fields.legend: What is the new address for?

options.label: Place of Origin
options.hint: The address where the animals begin their journey to Great Britain

options.label: Consignor
options.hint: This is the sender of the consignment.

options.label: Consignee
options.hint: This is the receiver or buyer of the consignment being shipped or transported.

options.label: Importer
options.hint: This is usually the same as the consignee. You can select a different person if needed.

options.label: Place of Destination
options.hint: This is where the animals will be unloaded and accommodated for at least 48 hours. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address.

options.label: Transporter
options.hint: This is the person or company responsible for transporting the consignment.

options.label: Branch Address
options.hint: This is the contact address of the person responsible for the consignment from when it enters Great Britain until authorities complete their checks.
